Card Q&A.a: Yes, when moving a card from your trash to your security stack, you must show the card to your opponent so they can confirm it's a yellow Digimon card.
Card Q&A.q: When using this card's effect to place a yellow Digimon card from your trash on your security stack, do I need to show that card to my opponent?

Effect: [When Attacking] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, place 1 yellow Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down.
